description: Source code for a custom formatter class 'RerunFormatter' used in the 'behave' testing framework to generate rerun files for failed scenarios.

classes.name: RerunFormatter
classes.description: A formatter class that outputs the locations of failed test scenarios for rerunning.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the formatter with stream opener and config, sets up internal state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state for failed scenarios and current feature.

methods.name: feature
methods.description: Sets the current feature being processed.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: At end of feature, collects failed scenarios if any.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the formatter, writes out failed scenarios or removes rerun file if none failed.

methods.name: report_scenario_failures
methods.description: Outputs the list of failed scenarios to the stream.
